{{Quote|My old man was a trooper. Member of the 407th. Always talked about "The Honor of the Armor."|[[Anson Trask]]|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 4">[[Legacy (2006) 4|''Legacy'' (2006) 4]]</ref>}}
The '''Honor of the Armor''' was a phrase used by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] who served the [[Fel Empire]] a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The Honor of the Armor described the pride and purpose a soldier felt when fighting as a stormtrooper for the good of the Empire.
